title: Product Comparison Videos for Clearer Choices | AIVideosUGC
description: Show shoppers the difference between your colors, sizes or sets. One photo of both options becomes a comparison clip for listings, Shorts and paid ads.
h1: Make a Product Comparison Video Shoppers Can Judge
lead: Use one photo that already shows both options, so the difference is the whole clip.
steps_h2: How to Make a Product Comparison Video in 3 Simple Steps
steps_lead: One photo of both options, a short description of the difference, then a file you can post.

steps.d: Upload one photo with both options fully in frame and at a similar scale. Even light keeps the difference easy to see.
Name the difference shoppers should notice, then pick a size and a length from 6 to 30 seconds.
Download the file and add variant names or prices in your editor. Post it where shoppers choose.

faq.q: What is a product comparison video template?
faq.a: A ready scene that puts two visible options in one clip. You bring a single photo that already shows both, and the result helps a shopper choose.

faq.q: How do I make a product comparison video?
faq.a: Upload that photo, name the difference you want people to notice, pick a size and a length, then download the file.

faq.q: Why start from a photo instead of a studio day?
faq.a: The clip is built from the photo you already have. You skip a second shoot when both options are already in that frame.

faq.q: Who is a product comparison video for?
faq.a: Shops that sell two sizes, colors, finishes or a set, and need the choice to read on a listing, a Short or a paid ad.

faq.q: What do I need for the first comparison?
faq.a: Put both options in one clear photo and name the difference in a short line. Download the file and check that both options are still easy to see.
One sharp frame with both options complete, at a similar scale, in even light. A photo of only one option cannot show the comparison.

faq.q: Which size and length can I pick?
faq.a: Use 1:1, 16:9, 9:16, 4:3 or 3:4. Lengths are 6, 10, 15 or 30 seconds, and the credit cost is shown before the job runs.
24 credits for 6 seconds, 40 for 10, 60 for 15 and 120 for 30. A failed job returns those credits. Plans start at $24.50 a month.

faq.q: Can I add names and prices later?
faq.a: Yes. Add variant names, measurements and prices in your editor after download. The file does not include names or prices.

faq.q: Can I run the file in ads?
faq.a: Yes. The download has no AIVideosUGC watermark and can be used in your own listings and paid ads. If a person appears, that person is an AI performer, not a customer.

steps.sourceTitle: Two sizes of a matte storage canister
steps.sourceHint: Keep the small and large slate-gray canisters, rounded lids and blank surfaces fully visible.
steps.prompt: An adult holds one small and one large matte slate-gray canister and raises both to the same height, so the size difference is easy to see.
